Jean-Jacques Goldman - Le grand concert de la Francophonie :

On August 25, 2025, the Agora du Vieux-Port de Québec welcomed numerous international stars for a moving tribute to Jean-Jacques Goldman, celebrating his 75th birthday and 50 years of his career. A celebration held without the artist himself, but carried by the emotion and talent of the guest performers.
